name: robots/brave-eai__dexjoco
title: DexJoCo bimanual assembly (MuJoCo scene)
intro: DexJoCo bimanual assembly (MuJoCo scene), adapted from brave-eai/dexjoco. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/brave-eai__dexjoco --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/brave-eai__dexjoco --backend fake --mcp
